content:
Alex: Heads up — last 48h we've gotten ~40 pages from eu-west1 gpu pools tied to short network flaps. Pages are noisy because the Prom alert fires on sub-1m blips.
Rachel: Saw the spikes. Looks like the alert is using a 30s window so anything <1m jitter becomes a page. We should gate paging on persistence and cluster-wide impact.
Sam: Can you paste the alert definition so we can see what to tune? Also, are these infra-level drops or application-level retries causing token reloads?
Alex: Here's the current alert from prometheus.rules:
```
alert: NetworkErrorBurst
expr: increase(node_network_receive_errors_total[30s]) > 0
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "network error burst on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```
Alex: The pattern is short (5-20s) packet loss affecting a handful of nodes in a single zone, then it recovers. But probe failures cause inference jobs to spike and downstream errors get paged.
Rachel: Proposal: split into two alerts:
  1) transient_network_blip (ticket) — uses max_over_time/increase over 5m and severity: ticket
  2) sustained_network_outage (page) — requires cluster/zone-wide hit and for: 10m
Rachel: Example revised rules (pseudo):
```
# recording rule to smooth blips
- record: node:net_err:rate5m
  expr: increase(node_network_receive_errors_total[5m])

# ticketing alert (no page)
alert: TransientNetworkBlip
expr: max(node:net_err:rate5m) > 2
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: ticket

# paging alert
alert: SustainedNetworkOutage
expr: sum by(zone)(node:net_err:rate5m) > 50
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Sam: I like that. Also add grouping by zone in Grafana alert manager so we don't page on 1 node flapping.
Sam: And add dedupe/backoff: if same zone has >3 blips in 30m, escalate to page even if each one resolves quickly.
Rachel: Agree. We should also add an annotation pointing to a short runbook: what to check (switch port flaps, ToR, infra NIC driver), and a dashboard panel showing per-node short-window percentiles.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0912 (automated) — linked to thread for reference.
Alex: I'll open a PR with the recording rule + change alerts + alertmanager grouping and sample silence windows. I'll include a test harness: synthetic flaps to validate no paging for single-node 20s blips.
Rachel: Nice. Also add a Grafana alert mute window for 03:00-04:00 UTC for planned backbone tests in eu-west1 (ops calendar). That reduces noise during maintenance.
Sam: For rollout, let's canary in eu-west1-staging first and watch pages for 24h, then roll to prod zones.
Alex: Assigned: Alex -> PR, Rachel -> review, Sam -> canary monitor. Target: PR by EOD Monday.
Rachel: Sounds good :thumbsup:
Sam: :+1:
Alex: thanks — will report back with PR link and test results.
